title: WPSS/166/2011 of SHAILENDRA DIMRI Vs STATE OF UTTARAKHAND AND ORS

paras.text:
IN THE HIGH COURT OF UTTARAKHAND AT NAINITAL
Writ Petition (S/S) No. 166 of 2011
Shailendra Dimri Ö Petitioner
Versus
State of Uttarakhand & others Ö Respondents
Mr. T.A. Khan, Senior Advocate, assisted by Mr. Aditya Kumar Arya, Advocate present for the
petitioner.
Mr. R.P. Sharma, Brief Holder, present for the State.
Mr. B.D. Kandpal, Advocate present for the respondent no. 4.
Honíble Sudhanshu Dhulia, J. (Oral)
1. A learned single Judge of this Court vide order
dated 09.12.2013 had directed that the defects be removed
within three days, failing which the writ petition will be
dismissed without further reference to the Bench. The order
dated 09.12.2013 reads as under :- ì
 Mr. T.A. Khan, Senior Advocate for the
petitioner, undertakes to remove the defects within
three days, failing which petition stands dismissed
without further reference to the Bench.
2. Admittedly the petitioner has failed to remove the
defects and the writ petition has been dismissed vide order
dated 14.02.2014 by the Registry. This dismissal will be
considered to be a dismissal in non prosecution of case.
Purely in the interest of justice recall application (MCC No. 36
of 2015) is hereby allowed and the order dated 09.12.2013 is
hereby recalled. The writ petition is restored to its original
number.
3. Heard learned counsel for the parties on merit of
the case.
4. The petitioner is an employee in the Industries
Department, Government of Uttarakhand. From the post of
Assistant Managers and Statistical Assistants promotions are
to be made to the post of Assistant Director/Manager in the

2
Department. These promotions are to be made from the
feeding cadre of Assistant Managers and Statistical
Assistants. The petitioner is a Statistical Assistant in the
department. However, the State had not decided as to what
would be the proportion while promoting Assistant Managers
and Statistical Assistants to the post of Manager/Assistant
Director.
5. During the pendency of the writ petition, a counter
affidavit has been filed by the State Government wherein they
have clearly stated that now a quota has been fixed and out of
the total 41% quota to both cadres now government is
proposing to amend and separate the total 41% quota to 31%
to Assistant Mangers and 10% to Statistical Assistants which
process is going on. The petitioner is satisfied with this action
and nothing further needs to be said.
6. As the proposal is already there before the
Government for fixing a quota of Statistical Assistants as well
as Assistant Managers nothing further needs to be done in the
matter. Let all consequential actions which have to be taken
at the level of the State Government be take in accordance
with law within a period of six months from the date of
production of certified copy of this order.
7. With the above observation, the writ petition
stands disposed. No order as to costs.
(Sudhanshu Dhulia, J.)
13.01.2015
Nitesh
